title: Check: Power of Two Choices and Hashing

questions.prompt: Many balancers all send their next request to the same least-loaded server at once. What's that called?
How does the power of two choices pick a backend?
options: Pick the two least loaded and alternate
Sample two at random and take the less loaded

questions.prompt: Different balancers sampling different random pairs is why power of two choices avoids stampedes.
When do you want hashing instead of least connections?
options: When the same key should land on the same backend, like a cache that already holds a user's data
When you have only one server

questions.prompt: Why is plain hash % N a poor choice for affinity?
options: Changing N reshuffles almost every key
